nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a > 0$ and $n > 0$ and an integer $b$, the modular linear equation solver on $a$, $b$, $n$ returns the empty array if and only if $\gcd(a, n)$ does not divide $b$.
nodes.title: The solver returns nothing exactly when $\gcd(a, n) \nmid b$

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a > 0$ and $n > 0$ and an integer $b$, the output of the modular linear equation solver on $a$, $b$, $n$ has $\gcd(a, n)$ entries if $\gcd(a, n)$ divides $b$, and no entries otherwise.
nodes.title: Number of residues returned by the solver

nodes.summary: Let $a > 0$ and $n > 0$ be natural numbers and $b$ an integer. A natural number $x$ occurs in the output of the modular linear equation solver on $a$, $b$, $n$ if and only if $x < n$ and $a x \equiv b \pmod{n}$.
nodes.title: The solver returns exactly the solutions below $n$

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $a > 0$ and $n > 0$ and an integer $b$, the entries of the output of the modular linear equation solver on $a$, $b$, $n$ are pairwise distinct.
nodes.title: The solver returns no repeated residues

nodes.summary: Let $a > 0$ and $n > 0$ be natural numbers, $b$ an integer, $d = \gcd(a, n)$, and $y$ the coefficient of $a$ in the Bézout identity $d = n u + a y$ computed by the extended Euclidean algorithm on $(n, a)$. If $d \mid b$, the list returned by the modular linear equation solver on $a$, $b$, $n$ is $[x_0, x_1, \dots, x_{d-1}]$ with $x_i = \bigl((y \cdot (b / d)) \bmod n + i \cdot (n / d)\bigr) \bmod n$, where…
nodes.title: Output of the modular linear equation solver

nodes.summary: Let $a > 0$ and $n > 0$ be natural numbers, $b$ an integer and $d = \gcd(a, n)$, and put $c = 4 + 3d$ if $d \mid b$ and $c = 0$ otherwise. The cost $T$ of the modular linear equation solver on $a$, $b$, $n$ satisfies $1 + c \le T \le 6(2 \lfloor \log_2 n \rfloor + 2) + 1 + c$.
nodes.title: Cost bounds for the modular linear equation solver

nodes.summary: Given natural numbers $a > 0$ and $n > 0$ and an integer $b$, the solver solves $a x \equiv b \pmod{n}$ following CLRS. Let $d = \gcd(a, n)$ and let $y$ be the coefficient of $a$ in the Bézout identity $d = n u + a y$ computed by the extended Euclidean algorithm on $(n, a)$. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
